__comment: Grafana Dashboard for Hermes Distributed KV Store. In production: use Grafana operator or ConfigMap.
title: Hermes Cluster Dashboard

panels.title: Cluster Health Overview
panels.description: Is there a leader? How many nodes alive? Current term.

panels.title: Request Latency
panels.description: P50, P95, P99 over time. Rate of requests. Error rate.

panels.title: Raft Internals
panels.description: Commit rate (ops/sec). Replication lag per follower. Leader change events (vertical lines).

panels.title: Storage Performance
panels.description: WAL write/fsync latency. MemTable size. SSTable count per level. Bloom filter hit rate.

panels.title: System Resources
panels.description: CPU per node. Memory per node. Goroutine count (leak detection). GC pause duration.
